mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu.questions (id, content, type, quiz_id, review_status, source_type, source_bank_question_id, source_question_id, version, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{content}, #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{quizId}, #{reviewStatus, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuestionReviewStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuestionSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{sourceBankQuestionId}, #{sourceQuestionId}, #{version}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE edu.questions SET content = #{content}, type = #{type, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.Question$QuestionType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, quiz_id = #{quizId}, review_status = #{reviewStatus, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuestionReviewStatus, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, source_type = #{sourceType, javaType=edu.ai.lms.core.quiz.app.domain.QuestionSourceType, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, source_bank_question_id = #{sourceBankQuestionId}, source_question_id = #{sourceQuestionId}, version = #{version}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
